inputs.text:
Look, we need to be completely clear about whose interests our political establishment actually serves. Once again, instead of addressing the deep structural inequalities crushing working-class families who are drowning in a housing crisis and struggling with the cost of living, we see the political elite focusing their energy on preserving wealth transmission and property transfer. 

Take Fianna Fáil TD John Lahart, who has come out calling for a reform of inheritance tax exemption thresholds, claiming the current system is ‘wholly unfair’ and discriminatory against those without children. Let's call this what it really is: a diversion. It is an attempt to protect and expand inheritance privileges that overwhelmingly benefit the already-propertied classes, ignoring the systemic reforms needed to uplift marginalized and vulnerable communities who will never inherit a dime. 

Lahart himself admitted the core of their grievance, stating, ‘At [...]’ revealing that their main concern is carving out more tax breaks for wealth accumulation rather than dismantling the deep economic divides that leave so many with nothing. We need institutional reform, but reform that taxes immense accumulated wealth to fund public services and housing for all, not tax cuts for the privileged few.
